title: Complement B, then intersect: a difference again
notes: A − B is A ∩ (not B). Complement B (ends in a becomes does not end in a), then build the intersection. The accepting pair is (p2, q0), the same one the difference example finds.
ops: start p0; accept p2; p0 a -> p1; p0 b -> p0; p1 a -> p2; p1 b -> p0; p2 a,b -> p2 | start q0; accept q1; q0 a -> q1; q0 b -> q0; q1 a -> q1; q1 b -> q0
